steps.title: Define resources and strings

steps.description: Enhance GeminiAutoSubmitService class to dynamically scan the entire active tree recursively for match conditions and click handling.

steps.description: Expose safe static logging hooks so the background service can output detailed diagnostic reports into the UI scroll view.

steps.description: Register the new Accessibility Service with BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE permission in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Modify Main Layout XML
steps.description: Update activity_main.xml to include Accessibility Service state indicators and settings navigation button.

steps.title: Implement CORS support on HTTP server
steps.description: Add Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers to response handling logic inside MyNanoHTTPD helper.

steps.title: Verify compile specifications
steps.description: Review Gradle build config and set parameters to remain compliant with SDK level 34.

steps.title: Building Local Gemini Bridge
steps.description: Compile resources, assemble APK files and execute test coverage routines under AGP 8.3.2.
